name: Island
description: The island over every app (ADR 0204): what the agents are doing, the asks that wait and the notices, a press away from answering and talking to Eris. Its settings say whether it shows.

desk.island.show.description: Show the island over other apps while the desk is not in front: the agents at work, the asks that wait, notices, and Eris a press or Option+Enter away, on every Space and over full-screen apps. Off, Option+Enter brings the desk forward with its talk line open.
